laws.rule: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, can bring jail. Owning drug-related equipment is illegal. Police may detain you while they investigate.
Legal drinking age 21. Alcohol can't be sold on Sundays.
Same-sex relationships aren't recognised and consensual sex between men is illegal. Avoid public affection.
Sunday activity is very limited; most businesses close, hotels and resorts run as normal. Prostitution is illegal.
Declare more than WST 20,000 (any form) on arrival and departure.
You need a temporary Samoan licence, from the Samoa Tourism Fale, the Land Transport Authority or some car hire agencies, on showing your Australian licence and paying a fee.

tourism.detail: Tourism with a return ticket and funds.

meetings.detail: A business visitor permit covers people paid offshore on a short trip: visiting a branch, negotiating, or attending a business conference.

conference.detail: A business visitor permit covers people paid offshore on a short trip: visiting a branch, negotiating, or attending a business conference.

unpaid-speaking.route: Business visitor permit or Temporary resident permit
unpaid-speaking.detail: Speaking at a business conference fits a business visit; other speaking may count as work.
unpaid-speaking.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

paid-speaking.detail: Work isn't allowed on a visitor permit; other business activity needs a temporary resident permit.
paid-speaking.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

book-launch.detail: Work isn't allowed on a visitor permit; other business activity needs a temporary resident permit.
book-launch.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

ai-teaching.detail: Work isn't allowed on a visitor permit; other business activity needs a temporary resident permit.
ai-teaching.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

remote-work.detail: No remote-work rule was found on the official pages.
remote-work.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

entrepreneur.detail: Exploring opportunities fits a business visit; running a business needs the business or work route.
entrepreneur.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

trade.detail: Meetings and negotiation are business visits; delivering work is not.
trade.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

artist.detail: Work isn't allowed on a visitor permit; other business activity needs a temporary resident permit.
artist.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

mixed-mission.detail: Visitor, business and work routes each cover different parts.
mixed-mission.next: Ask the Consulate General of Samoa in Sydney or Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

filming.detail: No filming permit process was found; the Film Production (Tax Incentives) Act 2017 covers foreign productions' tax.
filming.next: Ask Samoa Immigration and the Samoa Tourism Authority.

research.route: Temporary resident permit (academic or scientific research)
research.detail: Academic or scientific research uses a temporary resident permit through Samoa Immigration, with support letters from the sponsoring and a Samoan academic institution; holders can't work.
research.next: Ask Samoa Immigration (Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet).

volunteering.route: Entry and temporary resident permit arranged through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade with MPMC
volunteering.detail: For volunteers and project personnel, the Ministry's Bilateral Relations Division works with the Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet on permits, and an official letter from the Ministry is needed.
volunteering.next: Ask the volunteer program to arrange the Ministry's letter.
